rationale: The discourse has moved from rhetoric to a stable process agreement on audits and data, but the core conflict remains unchanged: employee/state actors insist on no closures and no compulsory redundancies, while management, owners, and investors refuse to rule them out. Since the parties are circling the same red lines and the next meaningful step is a procedural intervention to force quantified disclosure, further ordinary rounds are unlikely to resolve the impasse on their own.
